title: Biscuits & Sausage Gravy
ingredients: Biscuits from scratch: 2 cups flour; 1 Tbsp baking powder; ¼ tsp baking soda; 1 Tbsp sugar; 1 tsp salt; 6 Tbsp cold butter; ¾ cup buttermilk. Gravy: 1 lb breakfast sausage; 3 Tbsp flour; 2½ cups milk; black pepper; salt; optional pinch cayenne/sage.
instructions: Biscuits: heat oven to 450°F, cut butter into dry ingredients, stir in buttermilk just until combined, fold and cut, then bake 11-14 minutes. Gravy: brown sausage without draining all the fat. Sprinkle flour over sausage and cook 1-2 minutes. Slowly whisk in milk. Simmer 5-8 minutes until creamy; season heavily with black pepper. If too thick, add milk a splash at a time.
tags: biscuits gravy sausage breakfast southern
notes: You later chose store-bought bake-at-home biscuits, so the gravy is the key keeper here.

title: Black Walnut Vanilla Affogato Shaker
ingredients: 3 shots espresso; 1 scoop vanilla ice cream; 2-3 dashes black walnut bitters; 1 tiny drop almond extract; ¼ tsp vanilla extract; 1-2 oz milk; ice.
instructions: Stir half the ice cream into hot espresso for 10 seconds. Add bitters, almond extract, vanilla, milk, and ice. Shake 15-20 seconds and strain over fresh ice. Top with the remaining ice cream.
tags: coffee affogato black walnut bitters almond vanilla espresso
notes: Rebuilt from our creative ice-cream coffee conversation using the ingredients you mentioned.

title: Brown Butter Latte
ingredients: 2 shots espresso; ½ tsp browned butter; 5 oz milk; small drizzle maple syrup; ice.
instructions: Brown a tiny amount of butter until nutty. Stir ½ tsp of it and a small drizzle of maple into espresso. Add ice and milk; stir well.
tags: coffee latte brown butter maple espresso
notes: Recovered from prior chat.

title: Brown Sugar Cinnamon Espresso
ingredients: 2 shots espresso; 6 oz milk; 1 tsp brown sugar; ¼ tsp cinnamon; ice.
instructions: Stir brown sugar and cinnamon into hot espresso until dissolved. Pour over ice, add milk, and stir or shake.
tags: coffee espresso brown sugar cinnamon iced latte
notes: Recovered from prior chat.

title: Cajun Chicken & Andouille Pasta
ingredients: 8 oz pasta; ½ lb chicken, sliced; ½ lb andouille sausage, sliced; 1 Tbsp Cajun seasoning; 1 bell pepper; ½ onion; 2 cloves garlic; 1 cup cream; ½ cup chicken broth; ½ cup Parmesan; 1 Tbsp butter; optional lemon.
instructions: Boil pasta and reserve some pasta water. Brown seasoned chicken and sausage, then remove. Sauté pepper, onion, and garlic. Add broth and cream; simmer briefly. Stir in Parmesan, return meat, and toss with pasta. Loosen with pasta water and finish with butter and a squeeze of lemon.
tags: cajun pasta chicken andouille sausage creamy
notes: Standardized from prior Cajun pasta variants.

title: Chili-Lime Ahi Tuna Bowls
ingredients: Tuna: 2 ahi tuna steaks. Marinade: juice of 1 lime; 1 Tbsp soy sauce; 1 tsp honey; 1 minced garlic clove; 1/2 tsp chili powder; 1/2 tsp sesame oil; salt & pepper. Bowls: about 3/4 cup cooked cilantro-lime rice per bowl; avocado; pickled onion or cucumber; sesame seeds; scallions; optional yogurt crema.
instructions: Mix lime juice, soy sauce, honey, garlic, chili powder, sesame oil, salt, and pepper. Marinate tuna 10 minutes, turning once. Heat a skillet until very hot. Sear tuna 30-45 seconds per side for rare, or 60-75 seconds per side for medium. Rest 2 minutes, then slice. Build bowls over cilantro-lime rice with avocado, pickled onion or cucumber, sesame seeds, and scallions. Drizzle with reserved marinade only if it has not contacted raw tuna, or boil/reduce a used marinade for at least 30 seconds before serving.
tags: ahi tuna tuna steak chili lime seafood bowl rice seared sesame
notes: Recovered from our November 21, 2025 dinner. This was the tuna-steak dish paired with honey-lime carrots and mini tiramisu.

title: Chipotle-Style Chicken
ingredients: 1½-2 lb chicken thighs or breasts; 2 Tbsp adobo sauce; 1-2 chipotle peppers; 2 Tbsp avocado oil; 2 Tbsp salsa taquera; 2 Tbsp chicken broth; 1 Tbsp lime juice or vinegar; 2-3 cloves garlic; 1 tsp cumin; 1 tsp oregano; 1 tsp salt; ½ tsp pepper.
instructions: Blend or finely mince marinade ingredients and coat chicken. Marinate 30 minutes to 8 hours. Cook in a hot skillet or on a grill 5-7 minutes per side, to 165°F. Rest 5 minutes, chop, then return to the hot skillet for 1-2 minutes with a splash of broth plus a little adobo or salsa for charred edges.
tags: chipotle chicken bowls adobo meal prep spicy
notes: Recovered from prior chat.

title: Cilantro Lime Rice
ingredients: 2 cups rice; 2½ cups water or broth; 1 Tbsp oil or butter; 1 tsp salt; juice and zest of 1 lime; ⅓-½ cup chopped cilantro.
instructions: Rinse rice. Add rice, water/broth, oil or butter, and salt to rice cooker. Cook on white-rice setting. Rest 5 minutes, then fluff and fold in lime juice, zest, and cilantro.
tags: cilantro lime rice rice cooker side bowls
notes: Recovered from prior chat.

title: Classic Iced Americano
ingredients: 2 shots espresso; 6-8 oz cold water; ice.
instructions: Fill a glass with ice, add cold water, then pour espresso over the top. Stir lightly.
tags: coffee espresso americano iced simple coffee forward
notes: Recovered from prior chat.

title: Coconut Espresso Shake
ingredients: 2 shots espresso; 2 oz coconut milk; 3 oz whole milk; ice.
instructions: Shake espresso with ice until chilled, then add both milks and shake briefly again. Strain or pour over fresh ice.
tags: coffee espresso coconut milk shaken
notes: Recovered from prior chat.

title: Creamy Scrambled Eggs
ingredients: 4 large eggs; 1-2 Tbsp milk or cream; 1 Tbsp butter; salt; black pepper; optional shredded cheese or chives.
instructions: Whisk eggs with milk, salt, and pepper until uniform. Melt butter over medium-low heat. Add eggs and let sit briefly, then gently push soft curds across the pan with a spatula. Remove from heat while still slightly glossy; residual heat finishes them. Add cheese/chives if desired.
tags: scrambled eggs breakfast creamy easy
notes: Standardized from our breakfast conversation.

title: Creamy Southwest Chicken & Rice Skillet Casserole
ingredients: 1½ lb chicken, bite-size; 1 cup long-grain rice; 2¼ cups chicken broth; 1 small onion, diced; 1 bell pepper, diced; 3 cloves garlic; 1 cup corn; 1 can black beans, drained; 1 can Rotel; 2 Tbsp tomato paste; 1 tsp cumin; 1 tsp chili powder; 1 tsp smoked paprika; salt & pepper; 4 oz cream cheese; 2 cups shredded cheese; optional ½ lb chorizo; lime to finish.
instructions: Heat oven to 375°F. Brown chicken (and chorizo, if using) in an oven-safe skillet; remove. Sauté onion and pepper, then garlic and tomato paste. Stir in rice and seasonings. Add broth, Rotel, corn, beans, and chicken. Cover and bake 25 minutes. Check rice; bake 5-10 minutes more if needed. Stir in cream cheese and part of the shredded cheese. Top with remaining cheese and bake uncovered 8-10 minutes. Broil 1-3 minutes for color. Finish with lime.
tags: chicken rice southwest casserole skillet cheesy cast iron
notes: Recovered from prior chat. Chorizo was an optional flavor boost.

title: Crispy Sweet-Chili Chicken Breast
equipment: Convection toaster oven / air fryer-style oven
ingredients: 1½ lb chicken breast, cut into strips/chunks; ½ cup flour; 2 eggs; 1 cup panko; 1 tsp garlic powder; 1 tsp paprika; salt & pepper; cooking spray. Sauce: ¼ cup sweet chili sauce; 1-2 Tbsp mayo or Greek yogurt; 1 tsp lime juice; ½-1 tsp sriracha or chili garlic sauce.
instructions: Heat convection oven to 425°F. Season chicken. Dredge in flour, then beaten egg, then seasoned panko. Arrange on a rack/tray, lightly spray, and bake 15-20 minutes, flipping once, until crisp and 165°F. Mix sauce ingredients and serve on the side or drizzle just before eating.
tags: crispy chicken sweet chili convection oven panko spicy
notes: Standardized from our chicken-breast version after deciding not to blend the chicken.

title: Garlic Butter Chicken & Rice
ingredients: 2.2 lb boneless chicken thighs; 2 cups long-grain rice; about 3¾ cups chicken broth; 4 Tbsp butter, divided; 5 cloves garlic; 1 small onion; 1 tsp paprika; 1 tsp onion powder; 1 tsp dried thyme; salt & pepper; optional lemon and parsley.
instructions: Heat oven to 375°F. Season chicken. Brown in 2 Tbsp butter in an oven-safe skillet, then remove. Sauté onion and garlic in remaining butter. Stir in rice for 1-2 minutes, then add broth and seasonings. Nestle chicken on top. Cover tightly and bake about 30 minutes. Uncover and cook 5-10 minutes more until rice is tender and chicken is at least 165°F. Rest 5-10 minutes; finish with lemon and parsley.
tags: chicken rice garlic butter thighs one pan
notes: Recovered from the scaled 2-cup-rice version.

title: Garlic-Herb Pork Tenderloin
ingredients: 1 pork tenderloin (about 2-2½ lb); 5 cloves garlic; 1½ tsp salt; 1 tsp black pepper; 1½ tsp smoked paprika; 1 tsp onion powder; 1 tsp thyme; 1 tsp rosemary; 1 Tbsp Dijon mustard; ½ tsp red pepper flakes; ¼ tsp cayenne; 1-2 Tbsp oil.
instructions: Heat oven to 400°F. Mix garlic, spices, herbs, and Dijon into a paste; coat pork. Sear on all sides in a hot oven-safe skillet. Transfer skillet to oven and roast about 18-25 minutes. Pull at 142-145°F, then rest 8-10 minutes before slicing.
tags: pork tenderloin garlic herb spicy roast dijon
notes: Recovered from prior chat; temperature target preserved.

title: Gin-Forward Double NA Negroni
ingredients: 60 ml Ritual Gin Alternative; 30 ml Lapo’s Aperitivo; 30 ml Free Spirits Vermouth Rosso; 1 wide lemon peel; ice.
instructions: Add gin alternative, aperitivo, and vermouth to a mixing glass with plenty of ice. Stir 20-30 seconds until very cold. Strain over a large cube. Express a wide lemon peel over the drink, rub the rim, and drop it in.
tags: NA negroni mocktail gin forward ritual lapos vermouth lemon
notes: Standardized from our gin-forward double NA Negroni using the bottles you had on hand.

title: Healthy Cottage-Cheese Protein Cookie Dough
ingredients: 1 cup cottage cheese; 1 scoop vanilla protein powder; 2-4 Tbsp flour or oat flour (heat-treated if using wheat flour); 1-2 Tbsp peanut butter; 1-2 Tbsp maple syrup or sweetener; ½ tsp vanilla; pinch salt; 2-3 Tbsp chocolate chips.
instructions: Blend cottage cheese until completely smooth. Blend in protein powder, peanut butter, sweetener, vanilla, and salt. Stir in flour a little at a time until cookie-dough texture forms. Fold in chocolate chips. Chill 15-30 minutes for a firmer texture.
tags: cookie dough cottage cheese protein dessert healthy no bake
notes: Our key troubleshooting point was blending the cottage cheese long enough, ideally in a narrow high-speed blender cup.

title: Honey Cinnamon Shaker
ingredients: 2 shots espresso; 1 tsp honey; pinch cinnamon; 5 oz oat milk; ice.
instructions: Dissolve honey and cinnamon into hot espresso. Add ice and shake hard. Pour over fresh ice and add oat milk.
tags: coffee espresso honey cinnamon oat milk shaken
notes: Recovered from prior chat.

title: Honey-Lime Roasted Carrots
ingredients: 6-8 medium carrots or 1 lb baby carrots; 1 Tbsp olive oil; 1/2 tsp chili powder; 1/4 tsp cumin optional; salt; black pepper; lime zest; lime juice to finish. Optional glaze: 1 tsp honey mixed with lime juice.
instructions: Heat oven to 425°F. Cut carrots into roughly 3-inch by 1/2-inch sticks if using whole carrots. Toss with olive oil, chili powder, optional cumin, salt, pepper, and lime zest. Roast 20-25 minutes until tender with charred edges. Squeeze fresh lime over after roasting. For the honey-lime version, brush with 1 tsp honey mixed with lime juice during the final 5 minutes.
tags: carrots roasted honey lime chili side vegetable 425 oven
notes: Recovered from the same November 21, 2025 tuna dinner. This replaced broccoli as the side.

title: Iced Flat White-Style Espresso
ingredients: 2 shots espresso; 4 oz cold milk; ice.
instructions: Fill glass with ice and milk, then pour espresso over. Stir. Use less milk for a more coffee-forward drink.
tags: coffee espresso flat white iced milk
notes: Recovered from prior chat.

title: Instant Pot Pork Shoulder Enchiladas
ingredients: 3-4 lb pork shoulder; salt, pepper, cumin, chili powder, garlic powder; 1 onion; 4 cloves garlic; 1 cup broth; 1 can diced green chiles; 1-2 cans enchilada sauce; tortillas; 2-3 cups shredded cheese.
instructions: Season pork and place in Instant Pot with onion, garlic, broth, and green chiles. Pressure cook 60 minutes for ~3 lb or 70 minutes for ~4 lb; natural release 15-20 minutes. Shred. Heat oven to 375°F. Fill tortillas with pork and some cheese, roll into a baking dish, cover with enchilada sauce and remaining cheese. Bake 20-25 minutes until bubbling.
tags: instant pot pork enchiladas pressure cooker mexican
notes: Recovered from prior chat.

title: Instant Pot White Rice
ingredients: 1 cup white rice; 1 cup water; pinch salt optional.
instructions: Rinse rice well. Add rice and water to Instant Pot. Pressure cook on HIGH 4 minutes, then natural release 10 minutes. Fluff with a fork.
tags: instant pot rice white rice pressure cooker
notes: Recovered from prior chat.

title: Mexican Rice
ingredients: 2 cups long-grain rice; 2 Tbsp oil or butter; ½ onion, minced; 3 garlic cloves; 2½ cups broth; 8 oz tomato sauce; 1 tsp cumin; ½-1 tsp chili powder; salt & pepper.
instructions: Stovetop: toast rice in oil 5-7 minutes. Add onion and garlic, then broth, tomato sauce, and seasonings. Bring to a simmer, cover, and cook 18-20 minutes. Rest 10 minutes and fluff. Instant Pot: sauté/toast rice first, add remaining ingredients, pressure cook 3 minutes, natural release 10 minutes.
tags: mexican rice side instant pot stovetop tomato
notes: Prior alternatives for tomato sauce: salsa, Rotel, enchilada sauce, or broth + spices + lime.

title: Mini Individual-Glass Tiramisu
ingredients: 8 oz mascarpone; 1 cup heavy cream; 1/3-1/2 cup sugar total (2 Tbsp for whipped cream, 2-3 Tbsp for mascarpone, up to 1 Tbsp more to taste); 1 tsp vanilla; 3/4 cup cooled strong espresso or coffee; 12-18 ladyfingers; cocoa powder. Optional: 2 Tbsp coffee liqueur or rum.
instructions: Whip heavy cream with 2 Tbsp sugar and vanilla until soft-to-medium peaks form. In another bowl, beat mascarpone with 2-3 Tbsp sugar until smooth; add up to 1 Tbsp more sugar if desired. Fold whipped cream into mascarpone. Combine cooled espresso with optional coffee liqueur or rum. Dip ladyfingers only 1-2 seconds each. In individual glasses, layer soaked ladyfinger pieces, mascarpone mixture, then repeat once more. Finish with mascarpone. Cover and chill at least 4 hours, preferably overnight. Dust generously with cocoa just before serving.
tags: tiramisu mascarpone espresso ladyfingers mini dessert no bake individual glasses
notes: Recovered from our November 21, 2025 dinner. Eggless mini-glass version using the ladyfingers you already had.

title: Ninja Creami Cookies & Cream
ingredients: 1½ cups whole milk; ¾ cup heavy cream; ⅓ cup sugar; 1 tsp vanilla; pinch salt; 6-8 Oreo cookies.
instructions: Whisk milk, cream, sugar, vanilla, and salt until dissolved. Freeze in Deluxe pint on a level surface for 24 hours. Spin on Ice Cream. If crumbly, add 1-2 Tbsp milk and Re-Spin. Create a well, add broken Oreos, and use Mix-In.
tags: ninja creami cookies cream oreo ice cream
notes: Standardized from our Creami recipe discussions, designed to chase a Blue Bell-style Cookies ’n Cream profile.

title: Ninja Creami Creamiccino
ingredients: Strong chilled coffee or espresso diluted to about 1½ cups total liquid; ½ cup milk; sweetener to taste; optional vanilla or caramel.
instructions: Prepare a strong coffee base, sweeten while warm if using sugar, then chill. Add coffee and milk to the Deluxe pint without exceeding the line and freeze level. Process using the Creamiccino program. Adjust with a splash of milk if needed after spinning.
tags: ninja creami creamiccino frozen coffee espresso
notes: Standardized from our discussion of what the Creamiccino setting is for.

title: Ninja Creami Espresso Ice Cream
ingredients: 1¼ cups whole milk; ¾ cup heavy cream; 2-3 shots espresso, cooled; ⅓ cup sugar; 1 tsp vanilla; pinch salt; optional 1 Tbsp instant espresso powder for stronger coffee flavor.
instructions: Whisk everything until sugar dissolves. Freeze level for 24 hours. Spin on Ice Cream. Re-Spin with 1-2 Tbsp milk if needed. For more coffee punch, add instant espresso powder before freezing.
tags: ninja creami espresso coffee ice cream gelato
notes: Standardized from your requested espresso/coffee Creami.

title: Ninja Creami Mint Oreo
ingredients: 1½ cups whole milk; ¾ cup heavy cream; ⅓ cup sugar; ½ tsp peppermint extract; ½ tsp vanilla; pinch salt; optional green coloring; 6-8 Oreos.
instructions: Whisk base ingredients together, using peppermint carefully. Freeze level 24 hours. Spin on Ice Cream, Re-Spin with a splash of milk if needed, then add crushed Oreos with Mix-In.
tags: ninja creami mint oreo cookies cream ice cream
notes: Standardized from your Mint Oreo request.

title: Ninja Creami Oreo Milkshake
ingredients: About 2 cups vanilla ice cream; ½-¾ cup milk; 4-6 Oreos.
instructions: Add vanilla ice cream and milk to the Creami pint within the fill limits. Run the Milkshake program. Add Oreos and pulse/mix briefly or use a short Mix-In cycle depending on desired chunk size. Add milk for a thinner shake.
tags: ninja creami oreo milkshake vanilla ice cream
notes: Standardized from our Oreo milkshake conversation.

title: Ninja Creami Red Velvet Ice Cream
ingredients: 1½ cups whole milk; ½ cup heavy cream; 4 oz cream cheese; ⅓ cup sugar; 1 Tbsp cocoa powder; 1 tsp vanilla; ½ tsp vinegar; red food coloring as desired; pinch salt; optional red velvet cake pieces.
instructions: Blend base ingredients until completely smooth. Freeze level 24 hours. Spin on Ice Cream and Re-Spin if needed. Add cake pieces with Mix-In.
tags: ninja creami red velvet cream cheese cocoa ice cream
notes: Standardized from our red velvet Creami request.

title: Ninja Creami Tiramisu Ice Cream
ingredients: 1 cup whole milk; ¾ cup heavy cream; ½ cup mascarpone; 2 shots espresso, cooled; ⅓ cup sugar; 1 tsp vanilla; pinch salt; 4-6 ladyfingers or vanilla wafer pieces; cocoa powder.
instructions: Blend milk, cream, mascarpone, espresso, sugar, vanilla, and salt until smooth. Freeze level 24 hours. Spin on Ice Cream; Re-Spin if needed. Mix in broken ladyfingers/wafers. Dust with cocoa before serving.
tags: ninja creami tiramisu mascarpone espresso dessert
notes: Standardized from our tiramisu Creami conversation.

title: Orange Vanilla Latte
ingredients: 2 shots espresso; 5 oz milk; ¼ tsp vanilla extract; 1 strip orange peel; ice.
instructions: Express orange peel over the glass and rub it around the rim. Stir vanilla into espresso. Pour over ice and milk, then garnish with the peel.
tags: coffee latte orange vanilla espresso citrus
notes: Recovered from prior chat.

title: Rice-Cooker Spanish Rice
ingredients: 2 cups rice; 2½ cups chicken broth; ½ cup tomato sauce; 2-3 Tbsp salsa; 2 cloves garlic; ¼ onion, minced; 1 tsp cumin; ½ tsp chili powder; ½ tsp smoked paprika; salt & pepper.
instructions: Rinse rice. For more flavor, toast it in a skillet with a little oil for 4-6 minutes. Add rice and all remaining ingredients to the rice cooker and stir. Cook on the white-rice setting. Rest 5-10 minutes, fluff, and adjust salt/lime to taste.
tags: spanish rice rice cooker tomato salsa side
notes: Recovered from prior chat.

title: Roasted Carrots with Garlic & Spice
ingredients: 1½-2 lb carrots; 1-2 Tbsp olive oil; salt; black pepper; garlic powder; optional smoked paprika, red pepper flakes, and thyme.
instructions: Heat oven to 400°F. Toss carrots with oil and seasonings. Roast 30-40 minutes, turning once, until browned and tender. When pairing with pork tenderloin, start the carrots about 15 minutes before the pork goes into the oven.
tags: carrots roasted vegetable side garlic spice
notes: Recovered from prior chat.

title: Salted Caramel Vanilla Iced Latte
ingredients: 1 double espresso; 1 Tbsp vanilla syrup; 1 Tbsp caramel sauce; pinch salt; 6 oz milk; ice.
instructions: Stir vanilla, caramel, and salt into hot espresso. Fill a glass with ice and milk, pour espresso mixture over, and stir. For your usual style, cut the syrups to half amounts and add an extra shot.
tags: coffee latte salted caramel vanilla iced sweet
notes: Recovered from prior chat; adapted note preserves your coffee-forward, half-sweet preference.

title: Salted Vanilla Shaken Latte
ingredients: 2 shots espresso; 6 oz milk; ¼ tsp vanilla extract; pinch salt; optional ½ tsp maple syrup; ice.
instructions: Shake espresso, vanilla, salt, optional maple, and ice for 15-20 seconds. Pour over fresh ice and add milk, or shake milk in with everything for a frothier drink.
tags: coffee shaken latte vanilla salted espresso
notes: Recovered from prior chat.

title: Slow Cooker Pot Roast with Firm Carrots & Potatoes
ingredients: 3-4 lb chuck roast; salt & pepper; 1 Tbsp oil; 1 onion; 4 cloves garlic; 2 cups beef broth; 1 Tbsp Worcestershire; 1 Tbsp tomato paste; thyme/rosemary; 1½ lb baby potatoes; 1 lb carrots.
instructions: Season and sear roast, then place in slow cooker with onion, garlic, broth, Worcestershire, tomato paste, and herbs. Cook on LOW. To keep vegetables from getting mushy, add potatoes about 3 hours before the end and carrots about 2 hours before the end. Cook until roast is fork-tender.
tags: pot roast slow cooker beef potatoes carrots
notes: Standardized from our pot-roast timing conversation, with the late-add vegetable method you wanted.

title: Smoked Maple Latte
ingredients: 2 shots espresso; 6 oz milk; ½ tsp maple syrup; tiny pinch smoked salt; ice.
instructions: Stir maple and smoked salt into hot espresso. Pour over ice, add milk, and stir.
tags: coffee latte maple smoked salt espresso
notes: Recovered from prior chat.

title: Spicy Creamy Tomato Rigatoni with Sausage Meatballs
ingredients: 24 oz rigatoni; 2 lb Italian sausage; ⅔ cup panko; ½ cup grated Parmesan; 2 eggs; 6 Tbsp tomato paste; ½ cup chicken stock; 1½ cups heavy cream; 1 shallot, minced; 4 cloves garlic; red pepper flakes to taste; ½-1 cup pasta water; ½ cup Parmesan for sauce; 1-2 Tbsp butter; lemon juice/zest to finish; salt & pepper.
instructions: Heat oven to 425°F. Mix sausage, panko, Parmesan, and eggs; shape into meatballs. Bake 14-17 minutes, until cooked through. Boil rigatoni just shy of al dente and reserve pasta water. In a large skillet sauté shallot, garlic, and chile flakes. Cook tomato paste until deep red. Add chicken stock and reduce briefly, then add cream. Stir in Parmesan and enough pasta water for a glossy sauce. Toss in pasta, then meatballs. Finish with lemon and butter.
tags: pasta sausage meatballs spicy creamy tomato rigatoni no vodka
notes: This was the chicken-stock + lemon version built as the vodka substitute.

title: Thai Beef Coconut Rice Bowls
ingredients: For rice: 2 cups jasmine rice, 1 can light coconut milk, water as needed for cooker ratio, pinch salt, lime. For beef: 1-1¼ lb ground beef, 2 cloves garlic, 1 Tbsp ginger, 2 Tbsp soy sauce, 1 Tbsp fish sauce, 1 Tbsp brown sugar or honey, lime, chili sauce to taste. Bowls: cucumber, carrots, cabbage, herbs. Sauce: light mayo + chili sauce + lime.
instructions: Cook coconut-lime rice. Brown beef hard in a skillet, then add garlic, ginger, soy, fish sauce, sweetener, chili, and lime; cook until glossy. Mix the lighter chili-lime mayo. Build bowls with rice, beef, crunchy vegetables, herbs, and sauce.
tags: thai beef bowl coconut rice crunchy vegetables
notes: Recovered and condensed from prior chat.

title: Thai Red Curry Chicken
ingredients: 1-1½ lb chicken, sliced; 3 Tbsp Thai red curry paste; 13.5 oz coconut milk; ½ cup broth or water; 1 bell pepper; ½ onion; 3 cloves garlic; 1 Tbsp grated ginger; 1-2 Tbsp fish sauce; 1-2 tsp brown sugar; juice of 1 lime; optional basil/cilantro.
instructions: Sauté curry paste in a little coconut cream/oil for 1-2 minutes. Add garlic and ginger, then chicken. Add coconut milk and broth; simmer 8-12 minutes until chicken is cooked. Add onion and pepper and cook until crisp-tender. Season with fish sauce, brown sugar, and lime. Serve over rice.
tags: thai red curry chicken coconut milk spicy
notes: Recovered from prior chat.

title: Tropical Sunrise Fizz
ingredients: 2 oz pineapple juice; 2 oz mango nectar; 2 oz orange juice; ½ oz lime juice; 2-3 oz sparkling water; small splash grenadine; ice.
instructions: Add juices and lime over ice. Top with sparkling water. Slowly add grenadine so it sinks for a sunrise effect. Stir before drinking.
tags: tropical mocktail pineapple mango orange fizz breakfast
notes: Standardized from the prior Tropical Sunrise Fizz idea.

title: Virgin Espresso Martini
ingredients: 4 shots espresso; 1 oz cold water; ½ oz vanilla syrup; optional 2 dashes orange bitters; ice.
instructions: Add espresso, water, vanilla syrup, and optional bitters to a shaker packed with ice. Shake very hard 20-30 seconds. Double-strain into a chilled cocktail glass.
tags: virgin espresso martini mocktail shaken coffee strong
notes: Recovered from prior chat.

title: White Chicken Chili
equipment: Stovetop, slow cooker, or Instant Pot
ingredients: 1½-2 lb chicken; 2 cans great northern beans, drained; 2 cans diced green chiles; 1 onion; 3 cloves garlic; 4 cups chicken broth; 1 tsp cumin; 1 tsp chili powder; 1 tsp oregano; salt & pepper; ½-1 cup sour cream; 1½ cups Monterey Jack or pepper jack; lime.
instructions: Sauté onion and garlic, then add chicken, beans, green chiles, broth, and spices. Simmer until chicken is cooked, shred, and return it to the pot. Reduce heat and stir in sour cream and cheese until creamy. Finish with lime. Slow cooker: cook 6-7 hr LOW or 3-4 hr HIGH before dairy. Instant Pot: pressure cook about 12 minutes with natural release, then shred and add dairy.
tags: white chicken chili beans green chile creamy soup
notes: Recovered from prior chat history; multiple cooking methods were previously discussed.

title: White Chocolate Affogato Shake
ingredients: 3 shots espresso (about 90 ml); 1 medium scoop vanilla ice cream (~⅓ cup); 1 oz white chocolate sauce; 2 oz cold milk; tiny pinch flaky sea salt; optional ¼ tsp vanilla extract; ice; optional white-chocolate shavings or cocoa.
instructions: Pull espresso. Put half the ice cream in a shaker and pour hot espresso over it; stir about 10 seconds. Add white chocolate sauce, milk, vanilla, and salt. Add ice and shake hard 15-20 seconds. Strain over fresh ice, top with remaining ice cream, rest 30 seconds, then stir and drink.
tags: coffee affogato white chocolate ice cream shaken espresso
notes: Recovered from your saved recipe card. Variations: 1 tsp caramel; cocoa/shavings; ristretto for more punch.
